description: Split one column into several columns on a delimiter (e.g. 'full name' on a space), inserted in place; short rows are padded with empty cells. Returns the table in the same format. Use when one column packs several values. Do NOT use to clean or change format; use clean_table or convert_table.

column.description: Column to use: the exact header name (case-sensitive), or a 0-based column index as digits, e.g. "price" or "2".

data.description: The whole table as text, first row = header. CSV/TSV text (quoted cells allowed), or a JSON array of flat objects, e.g. "name,age\nAsha,30".

delimiter.description: Literal text to split on, e.g. " ", "-" or "|".

format.description: Format of 'data' and of the returned table: csv, tsv or json. Default csv.

new_names.description: Header names for the new columns; count must equal the maximum number of parts. Default <column>_1, <column>_2, ...

name: split_column

parts.description: Number of new columns the split produced.

text.description: The resulting table as text in the input format.

title: Split column
